class.name: PathExtrudeProfileBase
class.brief_description: A base class for defining the cross-sectional profile to extrude in a [PathExtrude3D] node.
class.description: This serves as the base for profiles that provide a cross section and optional end-cap geometry to [PathExtrude3D]. You can extend this class with a [code]@tool[/code] script and override [method _generate_cross_section] and [method _generate_end_cap] to provide custom geometry.

method.name: _generate_cross_section
method.description: An overrideable, virtual method for defining custom cross-sectional profiles using your own custom code. Populate the array with elements indexed similarly to [Mesh] [enum ArrayMesh.ArrayFormat] constants. [b]Note:[/b] You must use a [code]@tool[/code] script to see the mesh build in the editor.

method.name: _generate_end_cap
method.description: An overrideable, virtual method for defining custom end-cap meshes using your own custom code. Populate the array with elements indexed similarly to [Mesh] [enum ArrayMesh.ArrayFormat] constants. [b]Note:[/b] You must use a [code]@tool[/code] script to see the mesh build in the editor.

method.name: get_cross_section
method.description: Returns an array of Vector2s defining the cross section profile to be extruded.

method.name: get_end_cap_arrays
method.description: Returns the generated end-cap mesh arrays.

method.name: queue_update
method.description: Manually updates the cross section and alerts the [PathExtrude3D] to rebuild. This is called automatically, but you can call it manually if you need to.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the extruded profile will have its faces flipped, e.g. pipes become hollow tubes.
